headline: Is it too late to meet my soulmate?

voc.why: Pull ran and forced the health and fertility bans (transplant, cancer, stroke); counts not recorded.

note:
Soulmate age-band batch (2026-08-19), 65+ BINARY rung. ⚠ The hook is `cards-too-late-love`, NOT `cards-too-late` — that name is already taken by a MONEY lander ('Is something blocking my money, or did I just leave it too late?'). Wiring this under the money name would serve a woman asking about love a reading about her pension.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴🔴 NO HEALTH AND NO FERTILITY. The theme pull (sm-too-late, 2026-08-19) is thick with both — 'a heart condition and a transplant', 'ovarian cancer and therefore a hysterectomy', 'a recent stroke… multiple traumatic brain injuries', 'too late to have a baby', 'I'm 35 and hope not to settle down too late'. Health is a Meta-prohibited personal attribute and this funnel has no business near it. The read never mentions a body, an illness, children, or having a family.

🔴 NO AGE, NO NUMBER, NO DURATION. Never say she is old, never name or imply a decade, never say how much time is left. 🔴 BOTH VERDICTS ARE BANNED: 'yes, too late' is cruelty, and 'no, someone is coming' is a promise the funnel cannot keep. What IS allowed, under the 2026-08-19 directional loosening for loneliness and searching: the card does not show a door that has shut. That is the answer, and the CARD carries it.

🔴 NO SELF-BLAME — she must never be told she shut the door herself. The pull is full of people the world stopped choosing, not people who stopped trying.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — there's no wall and no door behind him, only sky.
You asked if it's too late to meet your soulmate. Your hand went to the man who is still working.
So no door has shut, dear. There isn't one on this card to close.
And nothing on that table is packed away, dear. It's all still out.
But you've been treating it as shut, dear. So you stopped trying the handle.
That's why you stopped looking, dear. You had no reason to keep checking.
Let me look closer at what put that door there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the rays at his head are short, and they all match.
You asked if it's too late to meet your soulmate. Your hand went to the card that waits with him.
So this card does not say late, dear. It has no way of saying it.
And the light at his head is still on, dear. Bright as it ever was.
But you've been reading it from underneath, dear. All of it looks late from there.
That's why late was the word that fitted, dear. It was the only one left.
Let me look closer at what turned you upside down in the first place…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his sleeves are slit, and there's red showing through.
You asked if it's too late to meet your soulmate. Your hand went to the one just setting off.
So there is no late on this card, dear. Nothing on it has a time to be there by.
And that card is the first in the whole deck, dear. Numbered nothing at all.
But you've been putting yourself near the end, dear. Counting from the wrong side.
That's why running out is how it feels, dear. You've been counting down, not up.
Let me look closer at what set that count going…
